_meta.source: 2026-09-26 user supplied 15 almanac photos (14 unique plants; Thunder Fruit duplicated), plus previously observed card prices.
note: 已核对 2026-09-26 用户 15 张图鉴照片：向日葵女王图鉴 500（此前误把运行时学到的 600 当权威——那是早期成本学习 bug 的污染值）。豌豆射手卡面 125 / 原版 100。
已知不一致：向日葵女王卡面 600 / 图鉴 500；豌豆射手卡面 125 / 原版 100。
tags 是给 policy.py 用的机器可读标签，effect_en 是给 Jev 看的英文效果说明。
combat contains almanac capabilities; explicit hit_factor and ambiguous damage bounds are estimates, not measured DPS.
Runtime card costs remain authoritative; new photos do not overwrite learned costs.
Cooldown seconds are almanac values, not exact observed slot cooldowns.

向日葵女王.effect_en: Sun engine that also fights. Produces 150 sun every 25s, burns zombies in the 3x3 area around itself for 40 damage/s, and fires homing fireballs at any lane.
effects: 灼烧周围3×3的僵尸，造成40/s伤害

combat.notes: Torch column: peas passing through her get fire boost; 3x3 around her is immune to slow/freeze (v4.0 wiki; fire boost confirmed by user 2026-09-26). Aura only damages nearby 3x3 targets; homing fire covers the board.
combat.price_source: User confirmed 2026-09-26: first 500, +100 per same plant on field

冰瓜香蒲.effect_en: Full-screen homing shooter that can hit any lane. Every hit slows the target, and 40% of its shots are a deep-freeze melon.

combat.notes: Almanac damage notation is ambiguous; use conservative lower bound. Splash slow and 40% special melon.

狂野机枪射手.effect_en: Heavy lane shooter. Fires a five-way spread of 20x4 shrapnel peas down its own lane every 2s; the spread means it still lands hits even when the lane is crowded.

combat.notes: 200/s is the theoretical five-angle total; scoring discounts misses by 50%, not a measured hit rate.

阳光炸弹.effect_en: One-shot bomb. 1800 damage in a 1.5-cell circle around itself, and every zombie it destroys is converted into sun instead of just dying.
effects: 自身为中心周围1.5格的圆

combat.notes: Sun per kill is unspecified; no invented numeric refund.

樱桃辣椒.effect_en: One-shot bomb covering its own lane plus the two adjacent lanes, 1800 damage each. Also melts ice trails and cancels freeze slowdown. Long 100s cooldown, so it is a real commitment.
effects: 自身所在一整行和相邻两行

combat.notes: Covers three full rows; also cancels ice slow. Damage does not guarantee killing high-HP enemies.

雪花寒冰菇.effect_en: Board-wide panic button. Rains ice on every zombie for 8s (20x100/s), then freezes the whole board for 3s and slows everything for another 15s. 4000 hp, so it can be planted out in the open.
effects: 之后冻结全场3秒并减速15秒

combat.notes: 20x100/s describes the ice rain; do not multiply that total by every enemy. Freeze follows the 8s rain, not immediate.

高冰果.effect_en: 8000 hp blocker that also shoots down its lane (20x8 every 1.5s). Attack and reflect both slow; reflect can freeze. Survives 8 hammer/crush hits. On death it releases an ice-shroom freeze. Price rises by 100 for every one already on the board.
effects: 可抵御8次锤击/碾压，每次扣血1000
受到外部寒冰菇效果回复1000血量
破损/亡语：释放寒冰菇效果
至尊金卡：场上每有一株该植物，价格增加100

combat.notes: Reflect is 1 per frame; frame rate unverified so no assumed reflect DPS. Costs 100 more per existing copy.

雷果子.effect_en: 4000 hp blocker with ranged lightning: 60 damage every 1.5s, doubled against armour, with a 25% chance to stun for 1s. Immune to lethal damage - instead it loses 800 hp and explodes for 800. Zombies biting it take 80/s reflect damage.
effects: 免疫致命伤害，改为失去800血并爆炸反弹800
反伤对啃咬自己的僵尸80/s

combat.notes: Reflect only while bitten. Lethal-hit mitigation loses 800 HP; not invulnerable.
combat.price_source: User almanac 2026-09-26: +100 per extra copy on field (23:24 实测 415/440/595 阳光连续被拒证实)

回收高坚果.effect_en: Cheap 8000 hp blocker that also stops jumper zombies. Unlike normal walls it can be reclaimed: shovelling it costs 800 hp and returns it to your hand as a card with whatever hp it had left.
effects: 每次铲除时扣除800血，若此时血量大于0，则变为卡片（保留当前血量）

combat.notes: Reclaim only if HP remains after paying 800; recovered card retains remaining HP. Agent shovel action implemented 2026-09-26 (shovel offered only when 800<hp<=2400 and the lane is pressured).

Cupid魅惑菇射手.effect_en: Fires 3 charm bullets every 2s; survives only 15s. Type-2 armor absorbs one hit. The ice-machine giant vehicle instead takes 1800 damage. Control-immune helmets are unaffected. Use against a valuable eligible wave, not as permanent firepower.
effects: 每2秒发射三枚魅惑子弹
二类防具会抵消一次击中
冰车巨人改为造成1800伤害

combat.notes: Type-2 armor absorbs one hit; ice-machine giant vehicle takes 1800 instead of charm. Immune control helmets unaffected. Enemy subtype unverified.

玉米卷香蒲.effect_en: Full-screen homing shooter that fires four tracking projectiles (corn, cattail, cabbage, butter) at any lane, with a chance to fire butter that stuns.

combat.notes: Butter probability unspecified; do not assume guaranteed stun. User 2026-09-26: passing through the Sunflower Queen torch column boosts damage.

冰冻坚果.effect_en: Cheap blocker that also shoots two ice peas every 1.5s. Whatever bites it is slowed and takes 20/s reflect. On death it freezes everything in a 3x3 area for 3s and slows for 20s. Can be evolved into Tall Ice Fruit. Can evolve into Tall Ice Fruit with an Evolution Bean (agent cannot use beans yet).
effects: 对啃咬的僵尸造成减速和每秒20反伤
亡语：冻结3×3范围内所有僵尸3秒和20秒减速
可使用进化豆：进化为高冰果（agent 暂无使用进化豆的动作，仅登记）

combat.notes: Death control is local 3x3. HP not shown in supplied image; do not assume 300.

阳光向日葵.effect_en: Cheap sun engine and the backbone of the economy. Pays 40 sun between 3 and 12.5s after planting, then 40 sun every 25s; after 120s it grows up and pays 75 sun every 25s.
effects: 120秒后长大，长大后每25秒生产75阳光

combat.notes: Growth age is not currently observed; mature income is not guaranteed for new plants.

寒光菇.effect_en: One-shot global freeze: releases an ice-shroom effect over the whole board, and produces 15 sun for every zombie it freezes. Doubles as an economy card when the board is crowded.
effects: 一次性植物，释放寒冰菇效果
每冻结一个僵尸生产15阳光

combat.notes: 15 sun per frozen zombie, not per kill; already frozen/immune targets may not pay.

睡莲.damage: Pea shots; exact damage and attack interval unverified
睡莲.effect_en: Water-only support layer that also fires peas down its lane. An ordinary plant can be planted above it without occupying another water cell. Peas are torch-compatible. Exact firing damage/cadence has not been verified; do not treat its modest firepower as sufficient against heavy pushes. Complete a planned top-layer placement immediately after verifying this base.

combat.notes: Pea shooting confirmed by user 2026-09-28; exact damage/cadence unknown. Tactical strength uses the existing conservative shooter fallback estimate, not measured DPS. Occupies the support layer, so a top plant can coexist.

豌豆射手.effect_en: Low-cost starter lane shooter, 20 damage every 1.4s. Useful for a small early threat; repeated purchases are poor substitutes for heavy firepower against armor or crowds.

combat.notes: Legacy catalogue estimate, not present in this image batch.

阳光花盆.effect_en: Roof-lane flower pot variant that PRODUCES SUN (user-confirmed 2026-09-28; amount unknown). Required before anything else can be planted on roof tiles - the same gatekeeper role as Lily Pad on water.

combat.notes: User-confirmed 2026-09-28: cost 75 sun, produces sun (rate unspecified). Roof gatekeeper: nothing plants on roof tiles until a pot is down.

花盆.effect_en: The pre-placed roof pot (field identity 66): plants go ON it.

combat.notes: Field furniture on roof levels; never a seed card.
